conduit.speaker: narrator
conduit.text: The conduit Speaker Oriel marked, and the grafting-seed she gave you. Set the seed and the conduit will grow. Yev is holding the seed like it is warm.

choices.text: Set the seed. Let it grow.
Yev, is this the grove's, or theirs?
Crush the seed. Log it planted.

yev_call.speaker: yev
yev_call.text: Both. That is the whole trouble. Set it. I will not let it be theirs.
